title: Model & Route Ops Deck: Annotated Wireframes + Chart Behavior Spec
creator: Anika Shah
description: Goal: Produce a cohesive set of annotated wireframes and interaction specs for a per-model and per-route operational dashboard that surfaces latency (p50/p95/p99), throughput (requests/min, tokens/min), token-level metrics (input/output token distribution, tokens per request), and cost attribution. This ticket focuses on page layout, widget interactions, chart behavior, and developer-facing drilldowns (microtrace links, sample prompts) so eng can implement with telemetry hooks. Primary audiences: runtime SREs, platform engineers, and product owners who need triage-first views for regressions and rollout validation.
scope:
- High-level deck layout (overview + diagnostics panes).
- Chart specs: percentile ribbons, distribution histograms, token-flow Sankey, cost waterfall, throughput sparkline, microtrace swimlane.
- Interaction patterns: aggregation window selector, compare-to-baseline, canary overlay, anomaly flags with root-cause hints.
- Export and share behavior: CSV export & deep link to route/model filtered view.
- Accessibility: color palette and contrast guidance for percentile ribbons and heatmaps.
chart_spec_highlights: Latency ribbon: stacked percentile area showing p50/p75/p95/p99 with adjustable smoothing window (default 5m).
Throughput sparkline: requests/min plus tokens/min overlay; hover shows request histogram for selected bin.
Token Sankey: top-10 token flow from prompt prefixes -> model response buckets; supports filtering by route and model variant.
Cost attribution waterfall: per-token cost delta broken down by batching, quantization, and infra tier (hosted/dedicated/private).
Microtrace swimlane: each lane = request trace; collapsible, with quick-jump to raw trace and sample prompt on hover.
Distribution histogram: request-level token counts with percentile markers and outlier thresholding for anomaly detection.
interaction_rules: Default time range: last 1h; user can change to 6h/24h/7d/custom. Charts should recompute aggregation client-side if range < 6h for smoother UX.
Canary overlay: show canary % as a semi-transparent band; clicking the band shows rollout metadata and comparison to baseline in the same chart.
Compare-to-baseline: toggle baseline from previous period or pinned stable model; show delta badges on card headers.
Drilldown: clicking a chart region opens the diagnostics pane pre-filtered (sample prompts, top error classes, relevant PR/commit if applicable).
Export: CSV export includes raw aggregated rows and an optional per-request sample column (limited to first 100 rows).
accessibility_notes: Use colorblind-safe palette for percentile ribbons (avoid red/green pairs).
Ensure minimum contrast ratio 4.5:1 for text and 3:1 for non-text foreground against background.
Provide non-color encodings: pattern or hatch for ribbons when 'colorblind mode' enabled.
acceptance_criteria: Annotated wireframes uploaded to Figma with all chart interactions documented.
Developer-facing spec includes required telemetry keys and example payloads (paths to Confluence table).
PM sign-off on metrics naming and aggregation windows.
Design review completed with EA accessibility checklist marked done.
Prototype demonstrates canary overlay and drilldown flow with realistic sample data.

decisions: Compute p50/p95/p99 on the server for >24h ranges; allow client-side smoothing for <6h to improve perceived stability.
Default aggregation window = 5 minutes for latency ribbons; user can change to 1m/5m/15m/1h.
Canary overlay will support segmentation by region and model variant; show meta tooltip with rollout % and start time.
Microtrace swimlane will include an opt-in sample prompt column to protect PII by default (redact mode enabled).
